Likelihood functions:
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Function returning 2 x the negative log-likelihood of a trace up to a constant
## The trace is assumed an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck with constant mean mu and rate
## parameter alpha. 
loglikOU.fun = function(pars, data, delta){
  ## pars = (alpha, mu, sigma) are the parameters to be estimated in the model:
  ## dXt = - alpha * ( Xt - mu ) dt + sigma * dWt
  ## data is a trace 
  ## delta is the time step between observations
  alpha0 = max(pars[1],0.001) #Ensuring alpha is positive
  mu0    = pars[2]            #Mean
  sigma2 = max(0,pars[3])     #Infinitisimal variance, should be positive
  n      = length(data)
  Xupp   = data[2:n]
  Xlow   = data[1:(n-1)]
  time   = delta*(1:(n-1))
  gamma2 = sigma2/(2*alpha0)  #Asymptotic variance
  rho0   = exp(-alpha0*delta) #Autocorrelation
  m.part = Xupp - Xlow*rho0 - mu0*(1-rho0) #Observation minus the mean of transition distribution
  v.part = gamma2*(1-rho0^2) #Variance of transition distribution
  loglik = - n*(log(v.part)) - sum(m.part^2/v.part)
  -loglik
}

## Function returning the estimated parameters
## Input is a data trace, the time step delta between observations
estimate.OU = function(data, delta, initial.values = NULL){
  if(is.null(initial.values)){
    n    = length(data)
    Xupp = data[2:n]
    Xlow = data[1:(n-1)]
    mu   = mean(data) ##Starting value for mu0 
    alpha = -log(sum((Xupp-mu)*(Xlow-mu))/sum((Xlow-mu)^2))/delta ##Starting value for alpha0 
    s2 = mean(diff(data)^2)/delta ##Quadratic variation, starting value for sigma^2
    par.init = c(alpha, mu, s2)   ## Collect starting values
  }
  if(!is.null(initial.values)) par.init = initial.values
  minuslogl = function(alpha,mu,sigma2){
    logLik = tryCatch(loglikOU.fun(pars = c(alpha,mu,sigma2), data = data, delta = delta))
    if(is.na(logLik))
      {
        return(10000)
      }else
      {
        return(logLik)
      }
    }
  temp = stats4::mle(minuslogl = minuslogl, 
             start = list(alpha = par.init[1], mu = par.init[2], sigma2 = par.init[3]))
  return(temp)
}

## Function returning 2 x the negative log-likelihood of a trace up to a constant from model
## dXt = - (a*(Xt - m)^2 + lambda) dt + sigma * dWt
## Assuming alpha0, mu0, sigma known
## Strang splitting estimator based on Taylor expansion around mu(lambda)
loglik.fun = function(pars, data, delta, alpha0, mu0, sigma20, pen = 0,k=1,method){
  ##pars are the parameters to be estimated, tau and a
  ##data is a trace under linear changing of lambda
  ##delta is the time step between observations
  ##alpha0, mu0, sigma20 are parameters already estimated in the OU process from stationary part
  tau     = pars[1]   #Ramping time
  a       = max(0.1,pars[2])    #Factor in front of (x-m)^2 in drift. Positive
  m       = mu0 - alpha0/(2*a)  #Constant mean shift
  lambda0 = -alpha0^2/(4*a)     #Stationary level of control parameter
  sigma2  = sigma20             #Infinitisimal variance
  n       = length(data)
  Xupp    = data[2:n]
  Xlow    = data[1:(n-1)]
  time    = delta*(1:(n-1))
  #lam.seq <- pmax(-10, pmin(10, lambda0 * (1 - time / tau)))
  lam.seq <- lambda0 * (1 - time / tau)
  
  
  if (method == 'continuous scale'){
    c.seq     = m + k*sqrt(-lam.seq/a)
    if (k==0){

      alpha.seq  = rep(0,length(lam.seq)) ## UPDATED
      rho.seq    = rep(1,length(lam.seq))
      
      ## Calculating the pseudo likelihood for the Wiener Integrator
      fh.half.tmp = a*delta*(Xlow - c.seq)/2
      fh.half.tmpupp = a*delta*(Xupp - c.seq)/2 
      fh.half     = (c.seq*fh.half.tmp+Xlow)/(fh.half.tmp+1)
      fh.half.inv = (c.seq*fh.half.tmpupp-Xupp)/(fh.half.tmpupp-1) 
      #mu.h        = fh.half*rho.seq + mu.seq*(1-rho.seq)  
      mu.h        = fh.half-lam.seq*delta ## UPDATED
      m.part      = fh.half.inv - mu.h
      var.part    = sigma2*delta*rho.seq
      det.Dfh.half.inv = 1/(a*delta*(Xupp-c.seq)/2-1)^2 
      loglik      = - sum(log(var.part)) - sum(m.part^2/var.part) + 2*sum(log(det.Dfh.half.inv)) - pen*n*(1/a - 1)*(a < 1)
      return(-loglik)
    }
  }else if (method == 'fix'){
    c.seq     = m + sqrt(-lam.seq/a)
  }else if (method == "MoAB"){
    c.seq = sapply(lam.seq, function(lam) {
      optimize(
        function(c) avg_absbias(
          c, lam=lam, m=m, sigma=sqrt(sigma2),
          a=a, which_well="all"
        ),
        interval=c(-3, 1)
      )$minimum
    })
    
  } else if (method == "MoAV"){
    c.seq = sapply(lam.seq, function(lam) {
      optimize(
        function(c) avg_absvar(
          c, lam=lam, m=m, sigma=sqrt(sigma2),
          a=a, which_well="all"
        ),
        interval=c(-3, 1)
      )$minimum
    })
  }else if (method == "average"){
    c.seq     = rep(0.25,length(lam.seq))
  }
  
  # alpha.seq  = 2*sqrt(-a*lam-seq)  
  alpha.seq  = 2*a*(c.seq-m) ## UPDATED
  gamma2.seq = sigma2/(2*alpha.seq)
  rho.seq    = exp(-alpha.seq*delta)
  
  Fc.seq     = -a*(c.seq-m)^2-lam.seq
  b.seq     = c.seq+Fc.seq/alpha.seq
  
  ## Calculating the Strang splitting scheme pseudo likelihood
    fh.half.tmp = a*delta*(Xlow - c.seq)/2
    fh.half.tmpupp = a*delta*(Xupp - c.seq)/2 
    fh.half     = (c.seq*fh.half.tmp+Xlow)/(fh.half.tmp+1)
    fh.half.inv = (c.seq*fh.half.tmpupp-Xupp)/(fh.half.tmpupp-1) 
    #mu.h        = fh.half*rho.seq + mu.seq*(1-rho.seq)  
    mu.h        = fh.half*rho.seq + b.seq*(1-rho.seq) ## UPDATED
    m.part      = fh.half.inv - mu.h
    var.part    = gamma2.seq*(1-rho.seq^2)
    det.Dfh.half.inv = 1/(a*delta*(Xupp-c.seq)/2-1)^2 
    loglik      = - sum(log(var.part)) - sum(m.part^2/var.part) + 
      2*sum(log(det.Dfh.half.inv)) - pen*n*(1/a - 1)*(a < 1)
  return(-loglik)
}

## Function returning the estimated parameters
## Input is a data trace, the time step delta between observations, and time passed
## at present since time t_0
estimate.tipping = function(data, delta, initial.values = c(100,1),  
                            alpha0, mu0, sigma20, pen = 0, k = 1, method) {
  
  par.init = initial.values
  
  minuslogl = function(pars) {
    
    # Reject invalid a immediately
    if (pars[2] < 0.15) {
      return(10000)
    }
    
    logLik = tryCatch(
      loglik.fun(
        pars = pars,
        data = data,
        delta = delta,
        alpha0 = alpha0,
        mu0 = mu0,
        sigma20 = sigma20,
        pen = pen,
        k = k,
        method = method
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        return(10000)
      }
    )
    
    if (!is.finite(logLik)) {
      return(10000)
    } else {
      return(logLik)
    }
  }
  
  temp = optim(
    par = c(tau = par.init[1], a = par.init[2]), 
    fn = minuslogl,
    method = "Nelder-Mead",
    hessian = FALSE
    #control = list(trace = 2)
  )
  
  return(temp)
}

## Function returning a trajectory up to a crossing time of X(t)  
## over the barrier as a function of
## the initial condition X0, the size of the noise sigma, 
## the integration time step dt, and the length of the simulation N
## and with time varying lambda:
X.traj <- function(sigma = 0.1, lambda0 = -2, tau = 1000, m = 0, a = 1,  
                   T0 = 0, X0 = sqrt(2), dt = 0.1, Ymax = 1000000){
  ##T0: Time before ramping starts
  ##Ymax: Max number of simulated points, if tipping does not happen
  Y = 0  ## Counting integration steps up to tipping
  xbarrier = m - 2 ## One smaller than crossing point at start
  Xtraj = X0
  X = X0
  ## Simulation during stationary period, constant lambda
  while(X > xbarrier & Y < T0/dt){
    X = S.onestep(sigma = sigma, lambda = lambda0,  
                  m = m, a = a, X0 = X, dt = dt)
    Xtraj = c(Xtraj, X)
    Y = Y+1
  }
  ## Simulation after lambda starts increasing
  while(X > xbarrier & Y < Ymax){
    time = dt * (Y - T0/dt) ## Time after lambda starts increasing
    lambda = lambda0*(1-time/tau)
    X = S.onestep(sigma = sigma, lambda = lambda0*(1 - time/tau), 
                  m = m, a = a, X0 = X, dt = dt)
    Xtraj = c(Xtraj, X)
    Y = Y + 1
  }
  Y = Y*dt
  return(list(FPT = Y, X = Xtraj))
}

## Function returning a simulation of the simple model one time step
## using the Euler-Maruyama scheme
S.onestep <- function(sigma = 0.1, lambda = 0, m = 0, a = 1, X0 = 1, dt = 0.1){
  dWt = rnorm(1,0,1)    ## Draws a random increment
  Y   = X0 - a*(X0-m)^2*dt - lambda*dt + sqrt(dt)*sigma*dWt
  return(Y)
}
```

average bias and variance functions:
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

Bias_fun <- function(c, lam, m, sigma, a,x,abs=FALSE){
  Nx  <- -a*x^2+2*a*x*c-a*c^2
  dNx <- -2*a*x+2*a*c
  d2Nx <- -2*a
  d3Nx <- 0
  
  A <- -2*a*(c-m)
  b <- c - (-a*(c-m)^2-lam) / A
  
  bias <- 1/24*(A*dNx*Nx+d2Nx*Nx*A*(x-b) -dNx^2*A*(x-b)) + 
    1/12*(A^2*Nx-dNx*A^2*(x-b)+d2Nx*A^2*(x-b)^2) -
    sigma^2/16*d2Nx*dNx
    
  
  if (abs){
    return(abs(bias))
  }else{
    return(bias)
  }
}

# Function definition
DVar_fun <- function(c, lam, m, sigma, a, x,abs=FALSE){
  Nx  <- -a*x^2+2*a*x*c-a*c^2
  dNx <- -2*a*x+2*a*c
  d2Nx <- -2*a
  d3Nx <- 0
  
  A <- -2*a*(c-m)
  b <- c - (-a*(c-m)^2-lam) / A
  
  Dvar <- (-1/12)*sigma^2*d2Nx*Nx -
    (1/3)*sigma^2*d2Nx*A*(x-b) +
    (1/6)*sigma^2*dNx^2 +
    (1/3)*sigma^2*A*dNx -
    (1/6)*sigma^4*d3Nx
  
  if (abs){
    return(abs(Dvar))
  }else{
    return(Dvar)
  }
}



inv <- function(x, lam, m, sigma, a) {
  exp(2 * (-a/3 * (x-m)^3 - lam*x) / sigma^2)
}

avg_absbias <- function(c,  lam, m, sigma, a, which_well = "all") {


  if (which_well == "all") {
    range <- c(m, Inf)
  }

  Z <- integrate(
    inv, m, Inf,
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
    function(x, lam, m, sigma, a)
      inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z,
    range[1], range[2],
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  integrand <- function(x) {
      Bias_fun(
      c = c,
      x = x,
      lam = lam,
      m = m,
      sigma = sigma,
      a = a,
      abs = TRUE
    )*inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
  }

  abs(
    integrate(integrand, range[1], range[2])$value * p_inv
  )
}


avg_absvar <- function(c, lam, m, sigma, a, which_well = "all") {

  if (which_well == "all") {
    range <- c(m, Inf)
  }

  Z <- integrate(
    inv, m, Inf,
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
    function(x, lam, m, sigma, a)
      inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z,
    range[1], range[2],
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  integrand <- function(x) {
    DVar_fun(
      c = c,
      x = x,
      lam = lam,
      m = m,
      sigma = sigma,
      a = a,
      abs = TRUE
    )*inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
  }

  abs(
    integrate(integrand, range[1], range[2])$value * p_inv
  )
}
```

Estimation on AMOC data. Choose linearization method
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
method <- 'fix'  ## can be {'fix','average','MoAV','MoAB','continous scale'}
k <- 1 # only matters if method = 'continuous scale', then c=m+k*sqrt(|lamda|/a)

## Read data
AMOC.data = read.table("AMOCdata.txt", header = TRUE)
t0     = 1924
## time: calendar time in years
## AMOC0: SST (sea surface temperature) in subpolar gyre, subtracted the monthly mean
## AMOC1: AMOC0 subtracted the global mean SST
## AMOC2: AMOC0 subtracted two times the global mean SST (Arctic amplification)
## GM: global mean SST

## Adding fingerprint with 3 times subtracted global warming for robustness analysis
AMOC.data$AMOC3 = AMOC.data$AMOC0 - 3 * AMOC.data$GM

## Estimating Ornstein-Uhlenbeck parameters from data up to year 1924
## before linear ramping of control parameter lambda starts

## Baseline data: Subset of data for the years 1870-1924

data.0 = AMOC.data[AMOC.data$time <= t0, "AMOC2"]
## Estimate parameters
temp   = estimate.OU(data = data.0, delta = 1/12)
alpha0 = unname(coef(temp)["alpha"])
mu0    = unname(coef(temp)["mu"])
sigma2 = unname(coef(temp)["sigma2"])

## Ramping data: Subset of data for the years 1925-2020
## Subtracted 2 times global mean
data.2 = AMOC.data[AMOC.data$time > t0, "AMOC2"]

## Estimate ramping parameters
temp = estimate.tipping(data = data.2, delta = 1/12, initial.values = c(100,1),
                        alpha0 = alpha0, mu0 = mu0, sigma20 = sigma2, 
                        pen = 0.004,k=k,method=method)
tau     = unname(temp$par[1])
a       = unname(temp$par[2])
m       = mu0 - alpha0/(2 * a)
lambda0 = -alpha0^2/(4 * a)
tc      = tau + t0

## Collect estimates
round(c(t0 = t0, alpha0 = alpha0, mu0 = mu0, sigma2 = sigma2, tau = tau, 
        a = a, m = m, lambda0 = lambda0, tc = tc),2)


# method = 'fix': tc= 2065.35
# method = 'MoAB': tc=2064.97
# method = 'MoAV': tc=2064.73
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#simulate a single trajectory using estimated parameters with method=method
nsim = 1   ## Number of simulations

#Define parameters
T0      = t0-1870      ## Time length of stationary dynamics (lambda constant)
sig     = sqrt(sigma2) ## Infinitisimal standard deviation: sigma
time    = AMOC.data$time 
n       = length(time)
lam.seq = lambda0*(1-pmax(0,(time-t0))/tau) ## Time varying lambda
alpha.seq = 2*sqrt(-a*lam.seq) ## Time varying alpha
mu.seq  = m + sqrt(-lam.seq/a) ## Time varying mu
var0    = sigma2/(2*alpha0)    ## Time varying variance
Delta_t = 1/12                 ## Time step in years (one measurement per month)
nloop   = 20                   ## Number of simulation steps between observation steps 
tp      = 2020 - t0            ## Time length of non-stationary dynamics (lambda linearly increasing)
nt      = ceiling(tp/Delta_t) ## Total number of points from t_0 to today

##Simulate process with lambda -> 0, starting at time t_0
xx = matrix(NA, n, nsim)

for (isim in 1:nsim){
  #Initial condition is random from stationary distribution
  x0 = m + sqrt(-lambda0/a) + rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sig/sqrt(2*alpha0)) 
  
  xxx = X.traj(sigma = sig, lambda0 = lambda0, tau = tau, m = m, a = a,
               T0 = T0, X0 = x0, dt = Delta_t/nloop, 
               Ymax = nloop*n-1)
  nx = length(xxx$X) ##If tipping happens before, trajectory is shorter than nt
  xxxx = xxx$X[seq(1, nx, nloop)] ##Only keep points at observed times
  nxx = length(xxxx)
  xx[1:nxx, isim] = xxxx
}

xxtime <- time[1:n]
xx.data = data.frame(X = c(xx), time = rep(xxtime, nsim), 
                     repetition = rep(1:nsim, each = n),
                     model = rep(m + sqrt(-lam.seq[1:n]/a), nsim))

## End of simulation of nsim paths
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Bias_fun <- function(c, lam,x,abs=FALSE){
  Nx  <- -a*x^2+2*a*x*c-a*c^2
  dNx <- -2*a*x+2*a*c
  d2Nx <- -2*a
  d3Nx <- 0
  
  A <- -2*a*(c-m)
  b <- c - (-a*(c-m)^2-lam) / A
  
  bias <- 1/24*(A*dNx*Nx+d2Nx*Nx*A*(x-b) -dNx^2*A*(x-b)) + 
    1/12*(A^2*Nx-dNx*A^2*(x-b)+d2Nx*A^2*(x-b)^2) -
    sigma^2/16*d2Nx*dNx
    
  
  if (abs){
    return(abs(bias))
  }else{
    return(bias)
  }
}

# Function definition
DVar_fun <- function(c,lam, x,abs=FALSE){
  Nx  <- -a*x^2+2*a*x*c-a*c^2
  dNx <- -2*a*x+2*a*c
  d2Nx <- -2*a
  d3Nx <- 0
  
  A <- -2*a*(c-m)
  b <- c - (-a*(c-m)^2-lam) / A
  
  Dvar <- (-1/12)*sigma^2*d2Nx*Nx -
    (1/3)*sigma^2*d2Nx*A*(x-b) +
    (1/6)*sigma^2*dNx^2 +
    (1/3)*sigma^2*A*dNx -
    (1/6)*sigma^4*d3Nx
  
  if (abs){
    return(abs(Dvar))
  }else{
    return(Dvar)
  }
}

a <- 0.86
m <- -1.54
sigma <- sqrt(0.3)


lam_seq <- seq(
  -2.73,
  0,
  by = 0.015
)

inv <- function(x, lam, m, sigma, a) {
  exp(2 * (-a/3 * (x-m)^3 - lam*x) / sigma^2)
}

avg_absbias <- function(c, lam, which_well = "all") {

  x_minus <- m - sqrt(abs(lam) / a)

  if (which_well == "all") {
    range <- c(m, Inf)
  }

  Z <- integrate(
    inv, m, Inf,
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
    function(x, lam, m, sigma, a)
      inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z,
    range[1], range[2],
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  integrand <- function(x) {
    Bias_fun(c, lam = lam, x = x, abs = TRUE) *
      inv(x, lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a) / Z
  }

  abs(
    integrate(integrand, range[1], range[2])$value * p_inv
  )
}


avg_absvar <- function(c, lam, which_well = "all") {

  x_minus <- m - sqrt(abs(lam) / a)

  if (which_well == "all") {
    range <- c(m, Inf)
  }

  Z <- integrate(
    inv, m, Inf,
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
    function(x, lam, m, sigma, a)
      inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z,
    range[1], range[2],
    lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a
  )$value

  integrand <- function(x) {
    DVar_fun(c, lam = lam, x = x, abs = TRUE) *
      inv(x, lam = lam, m = m, sigma = sigma, a = a) / Z
  }

  abs(
    integrate(integrand, range[1], range[2])$value * p_inv
  )
}

results <- lapply(lam_seq, function(lam) {

  bias_opt <- optimize(
    function(c) avg_absbias(c, lam = lam, which_well = "all"),
    interval = c(-5, 5),
    tol = 1e-8
  )

  var_opt <- optimize(
    function(c) avg_absvar(c, lam = lam, which_well = "all"),
    interval = c(-5, 5),
    tol = 1e-8
  )

  data.frame(
    lam = lam,
    x_star = m + sqrt(abs(lam) / a),
    c_bias = bias_opt$minimum,
    c_var = var_opt$minimum
  )
})
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
mhat <- -1.538967
mu0  <- 0.2479406

make_lambda_plot <- function(lam_value) {

  # Parameters
  a <- 0.86
  m <- -1.54
  lam <- lam_value
  sigma <- sqrt(0.3)

  x_star <- m + sqrt(abs(lam) / a)
  c_grid <- seq(m - 5, m + 5, length.out = 3000)

  # Unnormalized stationary density
  inv <- function(x, lam, m, sigma, a) {
    exp(2 * (-a / 3 * (x - m)^3 - lam * x) / sigma^2)
  }

  # Normalization constant
  Z <- integrate(
    inv,
    lower = m,
    upper = Inf,
    lam = lam,
    m = m,
    sigma = sigma,
    a = a
  )$value

  # Average absolute bias
  avg_absbias <- function(c_value) {

    range <- c(m, Inf)

    p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
      function(x, lam, m, sigma, a) {
        inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
      },
      lower = range[1],
      upper = range[2],
      lam = lam,
      m = m,
      sigma = sigma,
      a = a
    )$value

    integrand <- function(x) {
      Bias_fun(c_value, lam = lam, x = x, abs = TRUE) *
        inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
    }

    abs(
      integrate(
        integrand,
        lower = range[1],
        upper = range[2]
      )$value * p_inv
    )
  }

  # Average absolute variance
  avg_absvar <- function(c_value) {

    range <- c(m, Inf)

    p_inv <- 1 / integrate(
      function(x, lam, m, sigma, a) {
        inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
      },
      lower = range[1],
      upper = range[2],
      lam = lam,
      m = m,
      sigma = sigma,
      a = a
    )$value

    integrand <- function(x) {
      DVar_fun(c_value, lam = lam, x = x, abs = TRUE) *
        inv(x, lam, m, sigma, a) / Z
    }

    abs(
      integrate(
        integrand,
        lower = range[1],
        upper = range[2]
      )$value * p_inv
    )
  }

  # Evaluate bias and variance across the grid
  df_all <- data.frame(
    c = c_grid,
    well = "all"
  )

  df_all$absB <- vapply(
    c_grid, avg_absbias, numeric(1)
  )

  df_all$absVar <- vapply(
    c_grid, avg_absvar, numeric(1)
  )


  # Find minimizers independently
  search_interval <- c(-5, 5)

  c_bias <- optimize(
    avg_absbias,
    interval = search_interval,
    tol = 1e-8
  )$minimum

  c_var <- optimize(
    avg_absvar,
    interval = search_interval,
    tol = 1e-8
  )$minimum

  # Fixed point
  c_fixed <- x_star

  # Original special points
  special_df <- data.frame(
    well = "all",
    c = c(c_fixed, c_var, c_bias),
    absB = c(
      avg_absbias(c_fixed),
      avg_absbias(c_var),
      avg_absbias(c_bias)
    ),
    absVar = c(
      avg_absvar(c_fixed),
      avg_absvar(c_var),
      avg_absvar(c_bias)
    ),
    type = c(
      "Fixed Points",
      "Argmin E[|V|] subj. to Argmin E[|B|]",
      "Argmin E[|B|] subj. to Argmin E[|V|]"
    ),
    label_x = 20
  )

  extra_points <- data.frame(
    well = "all",
    c = c(mhat, mu0),
    absB = c(
      avg_absbias(mhat),
      avg_absbias(mu0)
    ),
    absVar = c(
      avg_absvar(mhat),
      avg_absvar(mu0)
    ),
    type = c("mhat", "mu0"),
    label_x = 10
  )

  special_df <- rbind(special_df, extra_points)

  # Legend labels, in the same order as the scale breaks
  legend_labels <- expression(
    "Fixed point (" * mu[t] * ")",
    "Minimizer of Average Variance (MoAV)",
    "Minimizer of Average Bias (MoAB)",
    m,
    mu[0]
  )

  # Plot
  p <- plot_average_bias_and_variance_AMOC(
    df_all = df_all,
    special_df = special_df,
    legend_labels = legend_labels,
    x_lim = c(0, 50),
    y_lim = c(0, 2),
    facet_text = expression(lambda)
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = bquote(lambda[t] == .(lam_value))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 24,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )

  return(p)
}
pp1 <- make_lambda_plot(-2.73)
pp2 <- make_lambda_plot(-0.86)
library(patchwork)
p_combined <- (pp1 | pp2) +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 2,
    guides = "collect",
    axes = "collect",
    axis_titles = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = NULL
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )
```
